body_lead: Uttar Pradesh will become leading state in AI, semiconductors, says Jitin Prasada The government’s objective is to make Uttar Pradesh a major hub for technology, innovation, research and manufacturing, and the necessary ecosystem for this is being developed rapidly across the state, says Union minister Jitin Prasada Uttar Pradesh will no longer remain limited to an electronics manufacturing centre but is rapidly moving to become the country’s leading state in AI, semiconductors, electronics, technology and innovation, Union minister of state for commerce and industry Jitin Prasada said at the...
